A current visible Result-owned Boundary Condition row exposes Paint Attached Faces. Revalidate the exact map, selection-aware workflow, visible row, locator and single capture before mutation. Existing owner/viewport/generation guards validate real Result-mesh rendering. Runtime state writes no XML, .vis or HDF; loading and errors remain capture-scoped.

Background and Result/Wind controls operate the same map-level particle session. Opening settings enables particles; settings may be edited without a source, and sampling starts only when an exact target exists. The native UI follows the retained editor-schema ranges: velocity scalar 1...1000, maximum lifetime 0...5, and particle count 100...10000. Typed input drafts preserve invalid raw text and show field-specific errors; existing out-of-range session values display unchanged and are never silently clamped, and only an explicit valid edit updates the session. Every mutation checks exact current MapState ownership before installation; background-window edits also verify the background session owner. These are MapState runtime settings and are not written to .vis. Low-level session and engine guards remain broader for internal callers and robust handling; they do not define the UI input range. No schema-only draft or parallel sampler is used. Zero lifetime clears live particles, transitions and trails before any spawn or division; returning to a positive lifetime resumes the existing source-field animation.

domainRelations.target: per-source map geometry snapshots and viewport cursors
domainRelations.semantics: Request one page per source per round so a dense first source cannot delay later source metadata. Pause stops all sources after the current page; resume preserves each source cursor. Failed sources retain their pages and cursor for retry; stale viewport/workflow responses cannot install.

The exact enum DepthTimesVelocitySquared serializes as D*V^2. Raster RGBA, point hover and dynamic profiles share the retained mapper over the selected Result profile arrays: depth times velocity magnitude squared; either source no-data value remains no-data. The selected Result profile uses the generic unit-specific display fill (USC range 0–20; SI range 0–7), with units ft³/s² or m³/s². The separate MapTypes DVSquaredDefaultValues metadata range is 0–30 and is not the visual ramp. Independent Legacy maximum depth and velocity summaries are not multiplied because that is not the maximum product; the unsupported summary request reports unavailable.

One independently checkable precipitation child per exact Boundary Condition owner. Inspect/frame/hover share the retained resampler and independent source timeline; direct and Result-owned HDF identities remain distinct. Full MapTree wire identity, source revision, separate context and capture tokens and compute lease guard every read. Zero paint transparency does not suppress a numeric zero hover. Camera changes cannot invalidate source inspection; frames use the latest viewport and reject stale replies. Currentness reads source-tree identity and visibility without resolving renderer payloads; payload lookup may validate currentness but must not recursively resolve its own render row.

domainRelations.source: retained source property validation attributes/current model draft and selected rows
domainRelations.semantics: The editor discovers edited validation fields without a mounted view. Untouched persisted inheritance sentinels such as NaN/blank are not new input errors; explicitly edited blank values remain subject to validation even after the field view unmounts. Every current request must finish without type/error severity before owner save, computation or selection navigation; warnings do not block. Changed values synchronously invalidate accepted replies; stale requests cannot reopen the gate. Errors and raw input stay with the current source selection, while Host staging remains the final persistence guard.

Starting GIS Mode creates an unsaved in-memory project with EPSG:900913 and CONUS extent after existing draft-replacement confirmation. Default background rendering starts immediately; Liberty style selection is optional and late replies require the same document/map/session. No project folder or recent file path is created until explicit save.

domainRelations.source: VelocityArrowsAnnotation/active Result or MultiResult slot-zero VelocityMapper
domainRelations.semantics: Arrow state and sampling are independent of particle state. The arrow endpoint reuses the retained VelocityMapper and terrain clip for the exact active Result even when its selected display map type is not Velocity; the particle endpoint keeps its existing Velocity constraint. The source annotation uses screen-spaced short streamlines and arrowheads; invalid, zero-speed and NoData samples never generate nonfinite geometry. Hidden, changed or writer-protected owners retire the previous overlay.

The retained ChannelModParentEditor contains the Version 6 HDF migration implementation and a handler for importing an existing RAS 2025 Classic Geometry file. In the decompiled source, Connect subscribes only Import6_Click; complete managed-source search found only the Import2025_Click definition, with no event registration or caller. The PRI confirms a ChannelModParentEditor.xbf resource exists but does not prove the button is reachable in the original UI. Reachability of the Classic Geometry handler is therefore unproven. The native ChannelV6GeometryImportControlView currently enables only Version 6 HDF and its “From 2025 Classic Geometry” item is disabled with an empty handler; without evidence that the original route was reachable, this is not a confirmed ordinary-operation parity gap. For the connected V6 route, a SHA-verified payload lives under the terrain import token; undo/redo reconstruct topology and profiles across requests, parent save commits and cleans the token, and cancellation/source changes/retired owners discard unadopted payloads.

domainRelations.target: GeometryTopologySession/GeometryTopologyProvider.validateRegionProperty/typed Host validation/parent save and mesh prepare
domainRelations.semantics: Raw Region property inputs and validation tasks belong to the topology owner and survive field-view or row changes. Requests bind the exact source, topology draft, selection and text; stale replies cannot replace newer validation. Pending or unapplied input and error/type-error severity block parent save and mesh prepare. Recommendation warnings remain visible and may be applied within absolute bounds. Host property mutation preserves warning severity instead of treating all validation results as fatal. Validation-task cleanup additionally requires a unique per-task token, so a cancelled request cannot evict its replacement when both have the same request ID.

The adapter exposes each saved terrain input original vector index; draft ordering and pending inputs cannot select a different map layer. Explicit user start selects or shows that exact source. TerrainInputMapCanvas publishes MapSourceRenderViewport from its live canvas size, shared map points, scale, offset and device scale; an inactive or hidden map canvas publishes nil and retires the camera-bound edit. Unchecking the exact polygon source clears its transient features and selection and ends editing while an active map keeps the shared camera. Triangle and Rectangle stamps and custom polygon drawing use retained observable polygon collections and edit operations, reconstructed from the parent-owned PolygonTopologyDrafts undo/redo journal across requests. The ordinary parent ModelEditor Name field and polygon settings stay separate from the structural operation journal. All changes commit through parent terrain save. Source/map coordinates transform in both directions with traditional GIS axis order and failure validation; geometry remains in source units. Pending inputs must first be saved before a stable map source exists. The native floating map toolbar and map taps share the same exact-owner action router. Raw invalid or unapplied placement settings block shape creation and the ordinary parent Save through a map-session-owned validation issue; Apply, Stop, hide, reload and discard release that issue. Idle pan or zoom updates the live camera without ending the edit; in-flight camera changes retire the stale operation. Save calls the registered parent Terrain editor and preserves its existing commit receipt. A map hit-test selection is navigation only: it preserves the parent model dirty flag and edit revision.

The Host creates Polygon Features rows from the retained TerrainPolygonTopologyEditSession and reuses each returned feature ID verbatim as the table row ID; metadata columns come from that feature. Parent table selections are validated against current rows and applied to the same source-backed map topology session. The accepted table-selection receipt binds the current selection generation, exact row IDs, and parent editor identities before and after the response; a generation increment alone cannot rebase a map capture. Concurrent selection changes during an in-flight topology request still reject its stale response. Map hit testing, placement, deletion, undo, and redo publish selected feature IDs back through the table presentation. Insertions, deletions, and history replay regenerate rows from the current topology session; commands carrying an older draft identity cannot use an index-backed ID to select the feature that inherited that index. Select on Map uses the registered parent editor, saved source vector index, exact active map and real canvas camera to focus the selected polygon. Parent Terrain save remains the only persistence path.

domainRelations.source: complete serialized map source tree/Geometry or Result-owned FlowArea
domainRelations.semantics: Hidden and unchecked FlowAreas have a properties-only inspector independent of render captures. Result and MultiResult owners resolve through their exact serialized ancestry and explicit slot-zero source; ordinary active-node rendering retains visibility gates. Nil source paths may materialize only with verified tree ancestry. Inspection reads the real mesh, settings mutations write only the map .vis with a committed receipt, and HDF source data and visibility remain unchanged. Writer-protected sources cannot open for diagnostics.

domainRelations.source: Terrain Inputs selected Polygon or Levee / TerrainLayersEditor source collection
domainRelations.semantics: Terrain Inputs navigates to the existing Terrain Modifications page without creating another editor or changing the selected terrain input. The workbench selects Raster Modifications for Polygon, Levees for Levee, and Channels for Channel when the selected input type changes or the page appears. Debug-only unsupported inputs retain their existing unavailable state. All changes stay in the same parent terrain draft.

The native file panel supports multiple sources. Import each through its existing vector, GDAL raster or GDB path; retain per-item source revision and actual visualization commit receipt. Duplicate selections are skipped and ordinary source failures may continue. Cancellation or a changed project/map/tree owner stops later items. GDB remains an explicit child-layer inspection/import flow; the batch waits for its actual outcome. A retired in-flight import drains the real commit receipt, or releases its waiter as cancelled if it fails; closing a sheet must not silently discard an already committed import. With no persisted map, the first valid layer and Project map commit together; adopt only its accepted exact serialized row/revision and staged project XML SHA. All-invalid input creates no map. Staged connection XML uses the live connection-then-description publication order, including new projects without Description. The batch Task returns its actual receipt directly; its published display receipt updates only for the captured current project session, and callers await the owning task instead of polling global state.

Blocking process and pipe waits run on Dispatch-owned queues, not Swift cooperative workers. One consumer suspends through a continuation; the producer blocks for capacity, preserving every event in order. Cancellation wakes pending waits and cleans the owning child; accepted terminal receipts still drain. Concurrent backpressured streams must not starve unrelated requests or their async event consumers.

The integer 0–100 setting persists only as RenderInEditMode on the selected Classification map node; omitted means 50. During Classification geometry editing, only the full Classification background raster receives this alpha. The selected-input overlay and normal map renderer remain unchanged. Host revalidates the exact HDF source revision and .vis owner before commit; editor rendering consumes the setting only when the active map selection and open Classification HDF path and SHA match. The persisted Project map is eligible through its fixed MapState.projectMapID after the same saved-map and node-owner checks. The SwiftUI draft identity includes the full associated-layer capture, HDF source SHA, and typed saved value; changing any of them recreates the control so a prior layer's pending slider value cannot move to a different owner. A successful Host response is a commit receipt; if subsequent revision acceptance, owner revalidation, or map refresh fails, retain committed status and show a saved-but-not-refreshed warning instead of inviting a duplicate retry.

Plan, Result and Terrain HDF references are kept in a registry separate from the Geometry/Boundary Condition capture dictionary, then explicitly composed into CoreLayerRequestContext.sessionHdfReferences. Each fresh Project reconstruction validates the context and the captured file path, SHA, actual kind and name before attaching the exact file in memory. The project format does not persist these references, requests cannot discover arbitrary paths, and Add does not copy the source. A missing sessionHdfReferences field decodes as empty; empty HDF references append no hash material, preserving the existing core-layer-context-v1 identity token byte-for-byte. A non-empty set appends a versioned, ReferenceID-sorted session-hdf-references-v1 section.

ResultPlanName is the label read from the external Result HDF and never creates or claims a Project.Plans member. Catalog keeps captured external Results out of the project-owned Result groups and groups them in a separate session MultiResult by embedded Plan name. SessionHdfResultOwner binds a deterministic external Result anchor by ReferenceID, project session/path, Result path/SHA, embedded Plan name and CoreLayerRequestContext token; it identifies the group, not the selected Result. The selected slot is separate: Latest follows the retained MultiResultVisualContext default/latest rule within this external group (current computing result if applicable, otherwise greatest ComputeSummary.EndTime), while an explicit selection retains its exact path and SHA only while valid. Map and chart requests validate both owner and slot, so same-named Project Plans/Results are not silently included. A MultiResult group has its own exact owner validation without child ParentResult fields. Hiding a saved group removes its checked flag but retains the Type/Name membership row so it remains selectable and can be shown again.

Only a successful committed Plan or Terrain save can rebase its exact session HDF capture. The Store checks the captured project session, current project revision, complete pre-save context and source path, then uses the committed snapshot SHA and name to replace the capture identity while retaining its original sourcePath. It recomputes the Core context token and invalidates/reloads assets, Catalog and map sources. An edit draft or Result source does not use this rebase path.

domainRelations.target: MapTreeSourceActionCommit / WorkspaceStore session HDF import and map property Apply
domainRelations.semantics: Build the complete response tree from the final in-memory map while the previous visualization revision is still current, then revalidate source identity before publication. Compute the committed SHA from the flushed temporary visualization before its atomic move. Once publication succeeds, the Host returns that prepared receipt without reopening the map, rebuilding its tree or rehashing the destination. The same boundary covers ordinary source actions and node settings such as associated raster style and mesh-error display. Swift preserves the actual typed commit status when revision acceptance, owner revalidation, reference registration or later refresh fails; a changed project cannot receive the old session reference, and a committed operation closes its retryable import presentation with an explicit saved-but-not-refreshed warning.

One map-scoped session owns the GeoJSON or Shapefile polygon draft, selection, sketch preview, undo/redo and save/discard lifecycle. GeoJSON edits an addressed ordered JSON tree with SHA-guarded atomic replacement; deleting a singleton root Feature converts it to an empty FeatureCollection, retaining unrelated root members and removing Feature-only members. GeometryCollection subgeometry deletion is explicitly rejected. Shapefile records retain all grouped rings, projection and XYZM through first-party staged write/readback and atomic family replacement. Multi-ring records write every ring XY first, then one record-wide Z range/array and optional M range/array, matching the retained reader layout. Each source ring uses the reader's exact Z/M dimension flags; optional PolygonZ M arrays are written per record and are not inferred from other records. The wire uses explicit dimension flags and JSON null slots for M NoData, converting these only to in-memory NoData values in the Host. The shared MapShapefileAttributeTableDraftWriter is used by ordinary Polygon and existing Polyline Shapefile save services; it preserves ordered raw field descriptors and inherited source-row bytes by exact row ordinal after checking typed values, encodes new defaults within captured widths, formats integers and fixed decimals without a lossy double round trip, and fails rather than changing schema or truncating values. Unknown inherited descriptors remain byte-preserved. Deleting the last record writes a valid zero-record SHP/SHX retaining the source shape type, zero-row typed DBF schema, and exact PRJ bytes so the map node remains addable; this differs from original R, which removes the source family for an empty collection. After Host commit, invalid receipts or failed Store refresh retire the old draft and require reload, preventing retry of committed edits. The Store publishes only an accepted exact new revision/family receipt. Stale owner/source responses cannot mutate a new map. GDB remains selection-only because the original GDB polygon context has no edit-layer or save caller. The existing Shapefile source loader carries an ordered, layer-level DBF schema independently of feature rows; the polygon session captures that typed schema and uses it for new records. The Host save receipt returns actual writer/reader-decoded values, semantic type, isSet and isNull for each committed row so an empty-layer Add appears in the active map layer and attribute table immediately and remains consistent after reopen.

Capture palette and pointer/key/hover input before queueing. A drag retains its initial owner; source switches retire previews and held sketch S/M modes. Dispatch uses the captured map rather than lastActiveMapID. Filter/Smooth/Offset previews do not mutate history; accepted vertex drags create one undo item. Save All and tab close use the draft source owner even after another layer is selected. Original ordinary Polyline Snap/SmartAdd have no terrain sampler and remain unavailable under that exact caller.

domainRelations.source: MapVectorSourcePart.HasZ/HasM + layer attributeSchema + source family capture
domainRelations.target: MapShapefilePolylineDraftService / MapShapefilePolygonDraftService / first-party ShapefileIO and shared attribute draft writer
domainRelations.semantics: Record optional M presence is explicit even when all ordinates are NoData; legal JSON uses nullable ordinate slots. PolyLineZ/PolygonZ records may independently omit optional M. Polygon rings in one record share dimensions. Write all closed-ring XY first, then one record Z range/array and optional M range/array, using exact per-record SHP lengths and SHX offsets. Preserve inherited DBF descriptor/record bytes and reject unrepresentable new values. GeoJSON merge provenance identifies each retained source vertex rather than guessing extra ordinates from coincident XY.

The original item owns one ConstructedResampler, original TIFF and converted preview; IsImporting defaults false and becomes true only after successful resampler construction. RequestTileHide sets that item's IsImporting false and sends that same resampler to Oui_TileHide for removal from the temporary raster preview; TryDownloadAndParse reuses an existing resampler and restores IsImporting. The final original import action submits only currently importing items. Swift keeps query outlines as a separate layer and renders each staged converted TIFF through the retained map raster source renderer, clipped to that product's exact projected boundary. Hide removes only that product's frame and pending raw-TIFF import membership; the receipt and cached frame remain for reactivation without another download. Each per-product receipt binds provider URLs, source and preview TIFF revisions, source conversion settings, and the query's exact Terrain input ID; the batch token owns all raw and converted files in the operation directory, while the owner binds the Terrain path/SHA and project session. The existing Terrain import sheet preserves R's AutoStitchData=true default and Stitch Tiles toggle; active product filtering occurs before the choice, and disabling stitch retains separate per-file appends. This transient product URL/preview receipt is not itself persisted into the project.

Keep Downloaded Files defaults false. When enabled, the default destination mirrors ProjectDirectory/Downloads/USGS Terrain and the user may select another local folder through existing security-scoped folder services. Before opening the Terrain append sheet, the session copies only exact raw TIFFs in handoff.files, the product set selected by the original Import action; hidden products in the same download batch are excluded. Each source is checked against its batch cleanup token, exact project/Terrain owner, input ID, path and SHA. Retention is independent of the later append outcome, so selected downloads remain when append fails or is cancelled, matching R's KeepDownloadedFiles cleanup intent. Source and copy hashes are checked, and an exclusive same-directory rename publishes without replacing a pre-existing target; provider filenames are retained with a numeric suffix on collision. If copying fails, the exact source remains owned by its temporary token for retry; ambiguous identity blocks that token until the user explicitly discards the temporary files. This option does not write the Project HDF or .ras.

Capture project URL/session and the current bundled Host client before async runtime.gdal. A changed project/session retires the request. Resolve ras from Contents/Resources/CLI, and GDAL tools/data plus one physical proj.db only from that app bundle Backend; reject development or ambiguous runtime paths. Export HECRAS_APP_PATH/RASROOT/GDAL_DATA/PROJ_LIB/PATH using shell literals, preflight version commands, then enter interactive non-login zsh. Each command script owns a UUID directory, removes itself before exec, and cleans only that directory on failure. CLI and Host initialize the same DSS/GDAL/thread-safe HDF policy in separate processes.

Carry exact serialized ancestor locators and canonical source paths. Precipitation routes only to its unique complete BoundaryCondition and optional Plan owner; Result-owned precipitation remains read-only. TerrainInput routes only through its unique matching Terrain ancestor. Refresh and revalidate session/map/workflow/assets/source/owner before opening; parent model transactions retain draft/save authority.

Retain unresolved raw text in the session, separate from committed source values. Finite/range/invariant integer checks precede typed model changes. Incomplete input blocks save/compute/tool preparation; remount retains it, stale source or selection cannot write through, and explicit per-owner discard or valid correction releases the gate. Escape retains unresolved raw text. Geometry region and display-unit transactions remain separate. Confirmed discard-and-reload invokes the parent discard transaction before reloading the same asset; a different owner, active operation or writer lock refuses without clearing unresolved raw text.

domainRelations.target: Backend and CLI native output roots
domainRelations.semantics: Distinguish actual LC_LOAD dependencies from the image own LC_ID_DYLIB. Resolve non-system absolute references only to unique contained candidates with equal compatibility/current versions and supported family/version aliases, then rewrite to relative loader paths and re-sign/strict-verify changed images. Missing, ambiguous or escaping targets fail the build. GDAL tool rpaths and existing ABI aliases remain active; no installed machine library is copied as a fallback.

Only producer callbacks copy the active writer OutputBlock culvert rows and embedded barrel geometry; target changes reuse owned snapshots, including earlier produced profiles. Do not open a second HDF reader or weaken stable Result SHA/read leases. Validate the exact Result or MultiResult owner, selected slot0 Result path, profile name/time, viewport, source ordinal and array counts before rendering. A target-set generation can carry multiple frames or unavailable events; reject lower generations, clear the current frame on unavailable, and retain running frames across ordinary progress updates. Target publication and registry replacement/rejection are ordered atomically. Source/profile errors stay local; target/owner replacement and terminal compute clear the writer state before stable loading resumes. Shared map particle enable/scalar controls both stable and live culverts; generic particle mode/lifetime/count do not alter culvert animation. Owned row payloads use at most 32 MiB of retained memory; later profiles spill to a private temporary binary store indexed by the original profile number. Validity bits distinguish failed rows from valid zeros. Reads reuse this store without touching the active HDF writer, and run disposal closes and removes the temporary store.

stateScopes.identity: project-session/map-workflow/Terrain-editor-draft/source-SHA/input-ID/query-extent/query-generation/ProductID/source-URL/raw-TIFF-SHA/preview-source-revision/per-product-input-ID/cleanup-token
stateScopes.rule: The USGS flow retains exact per-product raw and converted preview files under their download receipt while the user filters and changes import membership. Products start outside the import set; receipt acceptance activates only matching downloaded product IDs. A stale query, download or raster preview cannot publish under a changed project, map, Terrain draft, input or generation. Hide removes only its tile frame and import membership; the source and cached preview remain reusable. Cleanup waits for Terrain import reads and validates the captured project/Terrain owner.

stateScopes.identity: editor-draft/input/table/stable-row/column
stateScopes.rule: Only marked cells mutate source rows; selection stays ephemeral and cannot overwrite detail edits or the discard baseline.

stateScopes.identity: project/editor/load-edit/input/clipboard-batch
stateScopes.rule: The sheet owns one exact target and cannot dismiss during apply. Clipboard contents remain separate from source persistence.

stateScopes.identity: origin-plan-session/context/associated-source-SHA/row-token-name
stateScopes.rule: A source target is revalidated while reading files and loading the destination. Canceling model replacement retires it.

stateScopes.identity: map/node/context/slot-zero/source-terrain-SHA/profile/viewport/request
stateScopes.rule: Only an actual accepted numeric velocity field supplies particle motion.

stateScopes.identity: registered-editor-capture/project/reader-lease/duplex-operation
stateScopes.rule: The exact draft is frozen for export while cancellation and source progress remain available.

stateScopes.identity: map/project/workflow/operation/source-SHA
stateScopes.rule: Only the current verified batch publishes arrays or releases its task handle. Project replacement cancels outstanding reads.

stateScopes.identity: project/editor-source-revision/layer/component/timestamp/source-band-ID-and-revision
stateScopes.rule: Source switches affect only the captured component/timestamp. Reinspection retains a choice only when the exact band identity and revision survive; stale replies cannot adopt another editor or source. Cumulus is a separate provider capability.

stateScopes.identity: project-session/map-UUID/CRS/exact-viewport/settings/request-UUID/generation
stateScopes.rule: Only the current source response may publish; cancel/reopen of the same viewport issues a new request and ignores the canceled reply.

stateScopes.identity: OSM-TMS-z-column-row/cache-generation
stateScopes.rule: An explicit cache clear advances its generation; a network response captured before that clear cannot repopulate it after completion.

stateScopes.identity: compute-capture/run/result-path/map/node/slot/profile-time/viewport/target-sequence
stateScopes.rule: The writer owns the source Result. A replacement retires old targets; rejected new targets clear old subscriptions, and late frames cannot be accepted for a different current view.

stateScopes.identity: message-ID/project-session/exact-asset-kind-or-map-UUID
stateScopes.rule: Navigation requires the retained current message action and exact current owner; a reopened project session or same-name replacement cannot adopt the old action.

stateScopes.identity: project-source-revision/project-XML-fingerprint/canonical-Geometry-path/Geometry-SHA
stateScopes.rule: Backup writes use the retained source unique-filename operation; exact ownership is checked before publishing and source Geometry/project bytes are preserved.

stateScopes.identity: parent Geometry + source SHA + child ledger + feature IDs + output draft IDs + exact terrain dependency + current pointer/window/options
stateScopes.rule: Preview does not modify the HDF. Cancellation and late replies cannot accept another owner. Explicit apply appends one source operation to the same undo ledger; only parent save persists. Generated hydraulic attributes follow source defaults.

stateScopes.identity: project/editor/operation/run/Plan/Result path + map node + selection index
stateScopes.rule: The active Result can own a selection without a stable file revision. Slot zero identifies the actual logical keyframe; unreadable rendering is explicit. Terminal readable payload must match the exact actual source SHA.

stateScopes.identity: exact correlated run + output block + immutable source profile index
stateScopes.rule: Profile names/times come from source writer memory; gaps stay gaps, identical repeats are harmless and conflicting packets are invalid. Received profile metadata is separate from raster payload and source file readability.

stateScopes.identity: saved-map owner + exact node locator + selected Result path/SHA + current compute run/project/Plan
stateScopes.rule: Row additions, removals and selections change actual same-map transient visualization state. During compute, source reads stop while the last accepted choices stay visible; real callback identities may project current Latest progress but never form a stored candidate or write a source Result.

stateScopes.identity: project/map/context/source revisions + exact lines token + requested frame + async generation + overlay owner UUID
stateScopes.rule: All chart samples come from the selected source map. Line edits, frame changes, source replacement, cancellation or window disappearance reject late samples and clear only the current plot markers. Active terrain/Result choices in the same map rebind the existing window atomically after source setup completes; a changed project, map state or actual line owner retires it. Physical quantity and source units select distinct chart axes with one common station range.

stateScopes.identity: project session + editor operation token + accepted compute run UUID + callback Result path + terminal source SHA
stateScopes.rule: Project-specific transient rows never infer identity from labels, never read a solver-writing HDF, and merge only with the same canonical saved Result path.

stateScopes.identity: map UUID + project session/XML + source context + selected source slot and anchor SHA + whole Plan groups
stateScopes.rule: The composite is transient map state; it shares a keyed timeline, retires on owner replacement and restores original persisted source selections on Return.

stateScopes.identity: canonical-source-path-preload-SHA-postread-SHA-and-exact-selected-Result
stateScopes.rule: Capture source revisions before Project loads its HDFs, then bind actual loaded objects and materialize source code, severity, evaluated message and log data. Revalidate only attached sources. Missing diagnostics, read failure, changed source and loaded-empty remain distinct. Map MultiResult diagnostics belong to the exact selected Result and its matching SHA; catalog groups do not infer a first child. Diagnostic read failures never become source error messages. Live compute state is a separate run-bound contract described by live-result-compute.

stateScopes.identity: geometry-SHA-topology-fingerprint-selected-region-FIDs-axis-and-source-arc-FIDs
stateScopes.rule: The existing mesh response carries deduplicated source NS/EW side arc identities. The preview joins only to matching complete finite arc paths from that same topology snapshot; parent draft, revision or selection changes retire it. Hover is view state and never creates a separate save path; edits remain in the child mesh ledger and parent geometry save.

stateScopes.identity: project-session-assets-generation-project-XML-anchor-SHA-and-complete-group-identities
stateScopes.rule: The analysis tool explicitly chooses a saved project Result and loads actual inspector and plan-context providers. Acceptance checks the current project and source context, anchor revision and whole candidate groups before opening the existing keyed profile/map workspace. Dismiss the candidate picker before presenting the accepted workspace. This standalone route does not establish the original same-map Link Results active context or in-memory job support.

stateScopes.identity: project-session/exact-map/vis-SHA/exact-association-node/ordered-Geometry-or-Plan-or-Result-owners/source-dependency-SHAs
stateScopes.rule: Only the owning map visual node is changed. A committed Apply receipt is accepted before refresh; a stale context fails without changing source files. Dismissal cancels pending reads while submitted mutations finish under their map lease.

stateScopes.identity: project-session/map-index-name-type/vis-SHA/ordered-focused-Plan-paths-and-revisions
stateScopes.rule: Focused children carry one exact Plan owner; Matching Layers requires the complete focused set. Map deletion rebases source indices by receipt and retains surviving runtime IDs instead of joining names.

stateScopes.identity: map/result-node/chart-context/full-slot-overrides/slot-zero-SHA/profile/camera-generation
stateScopes.rule: The current keyframe owns embedded models and culvert arrays. Runtime controls do not become source schema. New profiles and owners cancel old reads; particle geometry follows source order and current camera resolution.

stateScopes.identity: project session UUID + source chooser scope UUID + canonical HDF + SHA + source row ordinal/token + async generation
stateScopes.rule: A display name cannot select another section. Cancel and project replacement retire in-flight reads; linked/pinned windows share source access leases without sharing selection state. The typed window route stores UUIDs only and disables restoration of stale section data.

stateScopes.identity: editor UUID + field storageID + current valid sourceValue
stateScopes.rule: Incomplete text is not a model value. It joins close/save/execute guards, survives page replacement, and clears on explicit discard/reload or a changed valid field baseline.

stateScopes.identity: original project path and SHA + canonical anchor/group Result paths and SHAs + requested profile index + generation
stateScopes.rule: Whole source plan groups are validated. The first Result is the time key; source KeyedProfileState chooses each child index and leaves unmatched children unavailable. Cancellation retires old responses.

stateScopes.identity: project session + asset revision + physical source path + load generation
stateScopes.rule: The original asset ID remains the navigation key. Only source-classified NValues may be associated as roughness; backing inputs are not model targets.

stateScopes.identity: boundary-asset/layer/source-SHAs/band-identities/inspection-generation
stateScopes.rule: File drop and native picker share the source inspection queue. Time Behavior is the retained transient enum choice, defaults to ProjectBackwards, and does not invent an absent time-projection algorithm or persistence field.

stateScopes.identity: project-session/physical-asset/source-SHA/preview-request-generation
stateScopes.rule: A preview owns a read-only source session. Project relative file resolution keeps the chosen project path, while canonical physical paths are identity comparisons only. Neither the active map nor an ordinary model draft is substituted.

stateScopes.identity: window/source-table/axis-and-dataset-identities/sample-bitpatterns
stateScopes.rule: Independent chart windows retain selection, viewport, tick density and font settings. Only the source IsLegendOverlay preference is shared through macOS UserDefaults. Changed source data reset the old viewport and cursor.

stateScopes.identity: projectSessionID/map-index-name-type/boundary-asset-ID/visualizationSHA/global-style-revision
stateScopes.rule: A native style sheet captures the original context and rejects changed maps, projects, assets, global defaults and external visualization files. Apply publishes only style attributes; Reset stages captured global defaults; Cancel writes nothing. Conditional XML and unsaved Views remain intact.

stateScopes.identity: application-preferences/source-definition-ID
stateScopes.rule: Global defaults survive project replacement. Duplicate source definition IDs retain one persisted key. Locally modified whole style options remain local when defaults change.

stateScopes.identity: project-session/map-index-name-type/root-node-path/source-file/vis-SHA/global-default-capture
stateScopes.rule: A layer edit writes only one exact persisted visual owner against its captured defaults. Renderer presentation updates preserve geometry drafts, selection, viewport and undo history.

stateScopes.identity: whole-plan-group-identities/profile-index/frame-mode/map-type/viewport/generation
stateScopes.rule: Every rendered layer belongs to one response and exact source frame; canceled or superseded requests cannot mix maps. Retained CPU rendering rechecks Result and terrain dependency files before returning.

stateScopes.identity: geometry-parent/selected-opening-row-IDs/coefficient/culvert-ledger
stateScopes.rule: The explicit mismatch reset command is restricted to KIn or KOut and preserves finite validation for ordinary numeric input. Only parent Save publishes the reset to HDF; undo/discard remain source ledger operations.

stateScopes.identity: editor-load-revision/context-generation/physical-geometry/source-SHA/owning-project-path
stateScopes.rule: Association edits cannot race a model or project operation. A same-owner ProjectXML rebase retains mesh and diagnostics drafts and re-evaluates source getters; changing the geometry/project still requires explicit replacement protection. HDF publication and Project XML persistence remain independent.

stateScopes.identity: focused-scene-action/backend-client/request-generation
stateScopes.rule: Only the currently focused workspace command presents its sheet. The state shows actual service data, loading or error; dismissal cancels and cannot apply a late response.

stateScopes.identity: projectSessionID/mapID/physicalSourcePath/baselineSHA/structuralFeatureComponent/draftGeneration
stateScopes.rule: Drafts and unfinished drawings participate in SaveAll/close/replacement. Shared-file edit gates recheck after asynchronous SHA validation; only explicit Discard clears drafts.

stateScopes.identity: projectSessionID/mapUUID/persistedMapLayerNodeID/canonicalPhysicalPath/familyKind
stateScopes.rule: The source file owns bytes and feature identities; each persisted map node owns display name, family filter, ancestor visibility and rendering identity. Repeated nodes may share one loaded source without sharing layer IDs.

stateScopes.identity: editorSessionID/sourceUnitFamilySelectionID/exactSourceUnitID
stateScopes.rule: The picker retains source option order and current ID. A missing current ID remains visible; changing the picker is presentation-only until a numeric value is explicitly edited.

stateScopes.identity: projectSessionID/mapIndex/type/name/rootNodePath/geometryAssetID/childNodePath/wholeVisSHA/globalStyleRevision
stateScopes.rule: An existing Geometry child is styleable only after exact source-tree and .vis identity resolve. Styles are scoped to the selected map and live Geometry asset; changes update .vis, not HDF, while pending Views and unknown XML survive.

stateScopes.identity: geometryEditorSession/source-topology-completion-operation/latest-build-result
stateScopes.rule: Source completion messages and per-feature highlights belong to one Complete operation. Do not substitute BuildConceptualMesh history or map-table diagnostics; an unprovided native callback remains unavailable.

stateScopes.identity: mapIdentity/visualizationSHA/nodeLocator/selectionIndex/contextToken
stateScopes.rule: Latest/previous/explicit overrides stay per-map in memory, normalize like source ResultSelection, and never add unsupported .vis attributes.

stateScopes.identity: windowRegistration/mapIdentity/sourceSnapshot/featureIdentity/coordinateSHA/draftGeneration
stateScopes.rule: Independent windows retain source snapshots, reject stale callbacks, and cancel/unregister on close; no global feature selection drives their identity.

stateScopes.identity: mapIdentity/nodeLocator/contextToken/keyProfileIndex/terrainDependencySHA/viewportGeneration
stateScopes.rule: Each active node owns its timeline. First-slot keyed time matching keeps no-match unavailable; ordered overlay publication must not combine viewport generations.

stateScopes.identity: presentation UUID + caller/action/kind + project session + assets revision + project XML fingerprint + canonical asset path + inspected SHA
stateScopes.rule: Tree/catalog/inspector share one coordinator; stale confirmations never attach to a newer identity.

stateScopes.identity: projectSessionID + canonical project projection + source/destination option and custom definition + ordered coordinate row IDs/raw X/Y + request generation
stateScopes.rule: Each transform is a read-only projection of the current full input. Changing project context, either projection, any row, file-identification side, or generation rejects late output. Unfinished and invalid values stay represented as text; blank, invalid, failed and unavailable output are distinct. Closing cancels outstanding work.

stateScopes.identity: standalone window session + complete raw WilcockDraft + source-indexed case identities + selected plot index + calculation generation
stateScopes.rule: Input changes retain text and make computed output stale until recalculated. Case selection uses a session identity mapped to the current source index; deleting a case preserves identities of surviving rows while shifting source indexes. BTM import requires confirmation before either same-grid append or different-grid replacement of STAB cases. No project, HDF or map is a persistence owner.

stateScopes.identity: Plan draft context + exact Project/Plan revisions + all read/write dependencies + source-selected output path
stateScopes.rule: Run performs fresh source inspection; execute revalidates the fingerprint. Terminal invalidates readiness while retaining the last result/log.

stateScopes.identity: editor owner + project session + dependency and write path sets + private cancellation nonce
stateScopes.rule: Close/save/model mutation remain blocked through source terminal and clean written-model reload. Cancel never substitutes process termination for source acknowledgement.

stateScopes.identity: project session, inspected file SHA, raw XML fingerprint, stage ownership tokens and dependency revisions
stateScopes.rule: Publish staged files and narrowly scoped metadata together. Trash inputs have recovery copies; failure restores them without clearing unrelated drafts or claiming success.

stateScopes.identity: owning editor, saved plan path/SHA and exact project metadata
stateScopes.rule: Selection is visual only. Keep unchanged Result identities across refresh; clear changed/removed sources and cancel superseded reads.

stateScopes.identity: source Build OperationID, captured topology and three-entry singleton lifetime
stateScopes.rule: Only the original caller's diagnostic branch adds entries; empty Build messages clear history, while Complete failure remains separate.

stateScopes.identity: serialized map index/type/name, geometry source and old visualization SHA
stateScopes.rule: An unfinished settings draft cannot silently change owner. Saving touches only its FlowAreaLayer attributes and preserves pending project and view drafts.

stateScopes.identity: selected Result group, expected revisions for all overlays, source polyline, mode and generation
stateScopes.rule: Only current source callbacks install chart data/progress; cancel stops the real process, and file changes invalidate the computation.

stateScopes.identity: result SHA, flow-area index, Cell/Face kind and map request generation
stateScopes.rule: Only a current complete viewport installs selectable elements; selected local element ordinals read stored HDF values and never write the Result.

stateScopes.identity: parent model revision, prepare intent and every captured child/ordinary draft
stateScopes.rule: Prepare runs after all draft application and never publishes a failed source stage; retry/discard owns the retained intent.

stateScopes.identity: current geometry child and visible unfinished draw/reshape preview
stateScopes.rule: A sketch is pending work for lifecycle guards, but those guards must not disable its own Apply/Cancel controls.

stateScopes.identity: current project session, canonical result path, source name and result SHA
stateScopes.rule: Validate before native Trash, retain other source files, and always retire matching in-memory references after successful Trash.

stateScopes.identity: project opening, .vis revision, serialized map index/type/name and node path
stateScopes.rule: Only one map/raster/removal writer runs; accepting external Maps preserves local unsaved Views and updates the exact disk baseline.

stateScopes.identity: parent model revision, topology fingerprint, child generation and save UUID
stateScopes.rule: Generation and patch edits are replayed in the same parent HDF staging context; a changed topology cannot silently rebase old mesh edits.

stateScopes.identity: model revision, source row identities, draft UUIDs and actual terrain dependencies
stateScopes.rule: Property-set changes and real sampled profiles preserve the shared parent draft and reject changed associated sources.

stateScopes.identity: canonical result path, HDF SHA and project XML context
stateScopes.rule: Embedded models remain result-owned; only the terrain association belongs to the current project draft.

stateScopes.identity: result SHA, block, variable, flow-area row, element index and request generation
stateScopes.rule: Chart/table selection never writes HDF; missing output is not replaced with demonstration data.

stateScopes.identity: prepared name/context revision, open project session and publication busy flag
stateScopes.rule: Create a real staged model with no overwrite, preserve unsaved XML and keep a published file discoverable.

stateScopes.identity: editor UUID, load/edit/context generation, plan SHA, canonical draft and exact project XML fingerprint
stateScopes.rule: Only the current draft can accept a source CanCompute response. Pure checking cannot acknowledge unsaved fields/events, change images, save files or enable solver execution.

stateScopes.identity: actual geometry asset plus real source extent
stateScopes.rule: Map/table selection uses source row IDs; view pan/zoom is independent of tag/size draft changes and all persistent model fields.

stateScopes.identity: editor load/source identity, field, unit IDs, original raw value and request token
stateScopes.rule: Local conversion is temporary. Cancel/disappear, model reload, field/unit change or failed validation invalidates apply; only an explicit current result can write the original scoped draft.

stateScopes.identity: message UUID, remaining monotonic duration and timer generation
stateScopes.rule: Dismiss/expiry only remove the card; historical messages remain available. Hover and window disappearance pause existing timers without replaying expired entries.

stateScopes.identity: source geometry path/SHA + source FIDs + model generation + parent save UUID
stateScopes.rule: Typed topology operations, metadata-column add/rename/delete, and vector imports stay in the same in-memory child mutation/undo history. A captured topology draft, ordinary fields and images share one staged HDF commit owned by the parent save. Old loads/edits/saves cannot acknowledge a different model or later draft.

stateScopes.identity: source Map index/name/type + native map UUID + original node index path
stateScopes.rule: Duplicate display names are valid. Exact source nodes own raster data and symbology. Source-map raster pixels are filtered before transforms, extents and rendering; blank maps additionally require explicit membership.

stateScopes.identity: old/new visualization SHA + source raster SHA + one project-opening provider
stateScopes.rule: Source sampling completes before atomic XML publication. Native acceptance rebases only Maps/Symbology and preserves unsaved Views. The project-operation lease blocks replacement while a write is running.

stateScopes.identity: request UUID + one terminal frame + UI operation generation
stateScopes.rule: Source percentages remain optional. Framing preserves split UTF-8; stdout/stderr drain concurrently. Cancellation stops the real child and stale progress cannot enter the next operation.

stateScopes.identity: source asset SHA, canonical internal window state, ordered event UUIDs and captured prefix
stateScopes.rule: Inactive custom dates survive inherited mode; source getters supply visible dates. Refresh and save cannot acknowledge later events. Discard drops canonical drafts and queued events together.

stateScopes.identity: project session, actual asset path and summary request revision
stateScopes.rule: Selected-node metadata is read from its own source schema; existing editor drafts and saved baselines remain independent. Late replies cannot cross asset or project selection.

stateScopes.identity: source path and SHA, authorized source folder, destination folder, inspection request UUID and isolated process
stateScopes.rule: Inspection is read-only. Conversion preserves source files and writes a new directory; cancellation may leave partial output. The current project is replaced only after success, sheet dismissal and the existing unsaved-change decision.

stateScopes.identity: project session, map ID, map kind and real source layer IDs
stateScopes.rule: Buildable maps display only explicit members; project maps follow loaded project layers. Per-map hidden IDs, transforms and extents do not leak across documents.

stateScopes.identity: asset ID, source revision, project context request revision and editor edit revision
stateScopes.rule: Read-only refresh retains drafts and refreshes the separate discard baseline; stale input/load/discard/save replies are ignored.

stateScopes.identity: asset SHA + original input ordinal + all original raster dependency SHAs
stateScopes.rule: Transform and explicit save use actual source objects. Even removed raster dependencies remain checked. Native source selection never replaces the saved baseline. Sampling replies are scoped to current source/input/load/edit identity.

stateScopes.identity: individual map view + overlay identity
stateScopes.rule: Collapse, placement, drag, size and opacity do not mark model files modified. Physical scale units require projection-aware metadata.

stateScopes.identity: editor asset SHA + immutable source feature identities + geometry command ledger + selection generation
stateScopes.rule: Geometry replay never changes source files until explicit save. Batch deletion is atomic for undo. New operations clear redo; successful save rebases history and navigation IDs. Draft class overrides survive delete/undo. Source dependencies and late map replies are revision guarded; XYM and XYZM preserve independent dimensions.

stateScopes.identity: sheet request UUID + editor asset revision + selected file identities/revisions/settings
stateScopes.rule: Changing file/name/column invalidates readiness until fresh source inspection. Shapefile sidecar hashes include attributes/projection/encoding and missing-file markers. Cancellation preserves model drafts; explicit import captures current edits and freezes mutation. Publication replaces HDF after source conversion/save; failures roll back new owned raster files.

stateScopes.identity: editor asset SHA + original input ordinal IDs + polygon ordinal IDs + raster dependency SHA set
stateScopes.rule: Opaque state holds source input order/removal, not presentation selection. Native priority order reverses source order. All scoped properties and mapping rows remain drafts until explicit source HDF save. Discard restores the original order, inputs and values. Immutable raster keys and input names sanitized to distinct HDF groups protect persistence.

stateScopes.identity: editor UUID + source model SHA + classification file SHA set + class-name row identity
stateScopes.rule: Opaque state restores mode/constant and explicitly edited association. Mapping keys are source class names, never visual row positions. Filter and selection never dirty the model; NLCD and classification changes remain discardable until explicit save. Hidden constant-mode mappings and missing association names survive observation.

stateScopes.identity: editor asset SHA + source and dependency SHA set + dataset connection + band + timestamp/component
stateScopes.rule: Inspection never saves. Unit/type and band metadata form one prepared selection. VRT dependency bytes participate in staleness checks. Explicit import saves captured model edits and source raster data in one staged HDF; failure retains original HDF and drafts.

stateScopes.identity: editor UUID + source revision + layer + component + canonical timestamp
stateScopes.rule: Frame selection is presentation-only. Preserve numeric and structural drafts and their separate discard baseline. A missing frame restores the last confirmed selection.

stateScopes.identity: editor UUID + source-provided unit family selection ID
stateScopes.rule: Unit choice affects form values, charts, tables and copying in the same session. Source values and file units stay canonical. Selection never creates a source edit; numeric user edits convert back through the published affine conversion before explicit save.

stateScopes.identity: editor asset path + SHA + shared station GUIDs + layer-specific input GUIDs + ordered structural records
stateScopes.rule: Shared stations do not share input data arrays. Names are persistence references rather than editor IDs. Explicit save rebases current identities; discard restores source state. Table rows are canonical and plots remain derived.

stateScopes.identity: editor asset SHA + baseline line/payload GUIDs + ordered source constructor/removal records
stateScopes.rule: Creation/deletion does not autosave unrelated drafts. Replaying records reconstructs current source collections; explicit save rebases identities and clears records. Discard restores the prior saved collection. Names never identify payloads.

stateScopes.identity: editor UUID + canonical asset path + source SHA + opaque line/payload GUID
stateScopes.rule: Original ordered lists have no persistent GUIDs; each editor owns the mapping. Rebase opaque state after save, preserve valid selection, and retain later edits against the new revision. Discard restores its baseline state and station shape.

stateScopes.identity: session UUID + load generation + row ID + column ID
stateScopes.rule: Standalone table drafts survive source-operation/export failures and are registered for termination; project replacement does not replace an independent shapefile document.

stateScopes.identity: project session + XML node identity + exact connection/path mappings
stateScopes.rule: Preview results and edit baselines cannot cross projects, shifted list indices, changed paths or closed sheets.

stateScopes.identity: projectSessionID
stateScopes.rule: Invalidates old work even when reopening the same project path.

stateScopes.identity: project URL and document instance
stateScopes.rule: XML draft and saved-byte baseline, separate from model HDF.

stateScopes.identity: standardized project path and preview-load revision
stateScopes.rule: Last-open time is recorded history, not file mtime. Removing a record never removes project files.

stateScopes.identity: definition type/value or exact search parameters plus request revision
stateScopes.rule: Only current source evaluation can enable creation/apply; stale search or validation replies are ignored.

stateScopes.identity: standardized source path
stateScopes.rule: Stable resource identity; display title is not identity.

stateScopes.identity: session UUID and loaded asset
stateScopes.rule: Independent fields, rows, images, samples, source revision and baseline.

stateScopes.identity: source object ID and scope
stateScopes.rule: The adapter chooses the schema and source binding scope.

stateScopes.identity: table ID, row ID, column ID
stateScopes.rule: Sort/filter positions never identify model objects.

stateScopes.identity: source multi-selection scope
stateScopes.rule: Mixed-value flags and explicit batch mutation targets.

stateScopes.identity: map UUID
stateScopes.rule: Viewport, tool, hidden layers and profile frame buffers are per map; production result integration remains pending.

stateScopes.identity: tree session and LayerTreeContext
stateScopes.rule: Catalog and map tree state remain separate.

stateScopes.identity: project/map/asset/feature context and request signature
stateScopes.rule: Preparation and execution share the same validated parameters.

stateScopes.identity: project session, request signature and selected source hashes
stateScopes.rule: Only the captured project receives new associations. Publishing a new HDF is not cancellable from the sheet; project replacement, save and application/window close are guarded until completion or failure.

stateScopes.identity: project session, selected plan path, request and source/destination hashes
stateScopes.rule: Source defaults join the owned destination state. Native save-panel approval permits replacement of a matching ZIP, while directories publish to new paths. Model-only save keeps project metadata dirty. The shared lease rejects concurrent source mutations. Export publishes after source operations finish and closes HDF resources.

stateScopes.identity: generation and input revision
stateScopes.rule: New text survives completion of older requests.

stateScopes.identity: page scope, dataset ID and source axis pair
stateScopes.rule: Display settings, axis windows and cursor interpolation never enter model edits. Profile requests also capture project/map/source context.

stateScopes.identity: region scope plus direction scope
stateScopes.rule: Unapplied text is view state. Source mutations and display fields are tracked separately, including across selection changes.

stateScopes.identity: origin plus project ID and open revision
stateScopes.rule: A library job does not own the workspace document. Closing invalidates replies; folder authorization waits for sheet dismissal.

stateScopes.identity: open revision and exclusively transferred ProjectDocument
stateScopes.rule: Cancelled/superseded reads cannot replace the current project; later drafts require confirmation.

stateScopes.identity: source SHA-256 or saved project bytes
stateScopes.rule: External-modification protection, not a UI reply generation counter.

stateScopes.identity: map-session/exact-node/source-path/source-revision/renderer-family/viewport-generation
stateScopes.rule: Plot options belong to transient renderer instances. Saved symbology remains in its existing persistence transaction. Responses only install for the captured owner, viewport and current request generation; transient vector overlays never enter feature identity, hit testing or export.

stateScopes.identity: stream-session/source-sequence/opaque-asset/streamable-sha256
stateScopes.rule: Use actual typed TIN stream records. Replay only validated assets from the application-owned cache across backend child processes. Closing or replacing a connection retires associated requests and assets; stream objects do not impersonate saved map nodes.

stateScopes.identity: map/node/logical-slot/result-path/result-revision
stateScopes.rule: Per-slot runtime choices remain distinct when two slots share the same Result. Compute writer leases and selected-profile availability still gate reads; diagnostic labels are actual renderer output.

stateScopes.identity: project-session/map/visualization-revision/canonical-directory/sorted-file-content-manifest/exact-layer-name
stateScopes.rule: The sorted manifest hashes all actual non-lock data files in the canonical directory and is shared by OGR vector children and GDAL raster subdatasets. Preview, import, render and style reads verify it with the exact map and child locator. Raster child filenames are GDAL connection strings, not standalone paths; vector rows preserve field types, unset versus NULL, XYZM and ring roles.

stateScopes.identity: project-session/map/background-settings/projection/camera/clicked-world-point/tile-address/compressed-source-sha256
stateScopes.rule: Read actual vector tile bytes through the normal service and cache policy. Serialize the retained tile protocol; write the clipboard only after an explicit menu action and current-owner validation. Disabled, unavailable and stale contexts produce no clipboard mutation.

stateScopes.identity: canonical-root-path + sorted-GDAL-local-file-path-length-and-content-SHA256-manifest + source-map-type
stateScopes.rule: Every local dependency returned by GDAL participates in preview, import and load currentness. Virtual sources are unavailable to local-file export/import identity checks. Store the original source and actual renderer type; display pixels are derived output.

stateScopes.identity: project-session + Geometry-source-SHA + topology-draft-identity + selected-Shapefile-family-captures + operation-generation
stateScopes.rule: Inspection is read-only. Apply re-reads and verifies selected families and mutates only the same loaded topology draft. The resulting operation shares the child undo history and parent HDF save; cancellation or stale replies cannot install another owner.

stateScopes.identity: operation-ID + project-session + exact-map-owner + destination-family + staged-member-SHAs + prepared-receipt
stateScopes.rule: The prepared receipt is retained in the app session before map import. .shp is the final synchronous publish step; retry import reuses the receipt and never reruns file creation. No persistent project record is written by the receipt.

stateScopes.identity: exact-map-node + source-and-vis-revisions + output-settings + destination-lease + duplex-operation
stateScopes.rule: Preview and execution use the same source and symbology capture. Cancel removes staged output; publish requires current input revisions, an absent destination and a receipt for the staged TIFF. Local/no-CRS projects retain geotransform without an invented projection.

stateScopes.identity: map-context-token + exact-Result-node + slot-zero-result-path-revision + profile + terrain-source-revisions + destination-family-lease
stateScopes.rule: Only a stored profile from the exact selected owner can be exported. Result and terrain dependencies are rechecked before publish. Required and optional sidecars are receipted before .shp is published last; Local projection leaves .prj absent.

stateScopes.identity: project-session + canonical-project-path + optional-project-revision + explicit-reference-captures + identity-token
stateScopes.rule: External references exist only in the running session. A request that reconstructs Project must explicitly carry the matching context; absent or stale context cannot attach arbitrary files. Clear captures on project-session/path replacement and rebase source hashes only after successful saves.

stateScopes.identity: stable-owner(project-session,map-ID,map-type) + mutable-capture-epoch(workflow-identity,MapTreeMapIdentity) + source-revisions + request-generation
stateScopes.rule: Same-owner epoch changes preserve editable recipe/name/visibility/profile but cancel prior work and inspect the new context. Evaluation requires every captured source identity and availability to match. Failure clears stale layer and whole-source bounds while retaining the entry and error.

stateScopes.identity: project-session-map-workflow-exact-row-layer-source-revision-selected-stable-feature-identities
stateScopes.rule: Both canvas hits and filtered feature rows capture the same menu context and share one action dispatcher. Preserve an already-selected set or add under Control. Resolve row and layer by exact identity; changed project XML, visualization or Core context invalidates an old menu even while the previous rendered rows remain cached.

stateScopes.identity: project-session-map-context-Result-node-logical-slot-zero-result-path-SHA-selected-barrel-ordinals-request-generation
stateScopes.rule: Read the actual OutputBlock.Times and Flow or OutletVelocity for each selected source barrel ordinal. Keep source units and NoData; never replace a time series with a single-frame particle profile or a spatial sample. Close and source changes retire pending loads; retain already-read chart data with a stale indication.

stateScopes.identity: project-session-Geometry-model-source-revision-mesh-and-topology-draft-SHAs-flow-area-ID-name-element-kind-index-operation-ID
stateScopes.rule: Replay the captured parent-owned drafts without saving the Geometry. Find returns exact coordinates and source viewport for a cell, face or node. Export actual centers or perimeter polylines with typed original attributes and project CRS. Prepare artifact receipts before no-clobber publication and preserve them after commit, even if UI currentness or cleanup subsequently fails.

stateScopes.identity: GeometryMeshToolsOwnerCapture/element-kind/index/property-table-source-revision
stateScopes.rule: The chart belongs to one captured Geometry child draft and source element. A changed source owner, topology, Flow Area, project context or selection invalidates the request. Missing property tables are computed through the existing child session; the page owns progress/cancel and re-finds the element with the new draft SHA before querying the chart. Parent save persists the child draft to HDF but is not required for charting.

stateScopes.identity: geometry-owner/map-ID/project-session/CoreLayerRequestContext/map-workflow/accepted-result-snapshot/selection-overrides/flow-area-and-element
stateScopes.rule: Capture the selected saved map and accepted source snapshot at the explicit user action. All asynchronous inspect and execute work uses that capture; owner, workflow, snapshot, selection or Geometry changes retire the response. Only exact same-mesh slot-0 Result series are accepted.

stateScopes.identity: map-workflow/source-locators-and-SHAs/GDB-manifest-and-subdataset/result-selections-and-profile/model-and-mesh-draft/pointer-generation
stateScopes.rule: Cancel or retire old reads on pointer, tool, project, map or source changes. Validate response entries against their exact source captures before merging with local vector hits; preserve explicit no-clear raster sampling semantics. Model labels and numeric entries must match the same outer node and source revision; nonnegative original model feature indices are distinct from paged display positions.

stateScopes.identity: editor-load/source-SHA/draft/input-revision/selection-revision/exact-row-and-feature-IDs
stateScopes.rule: Keep mixed-value placeholder distinct from a concrete first-row value. Explicit force-set carries the complete captured selection and original command identifier. Never install a late result after the editor, source, draft or selected set changes.

stateScopes.identity: exact-map-capture/project-session/source-SHA/unique-parent-editor/model-request/child-draft
stateScopes.rule: A map task may prepare the one current child, but cannot save it or substitute another owner. Publish draft bounds only into the shared map source session; preserve established camera references and clear retired overrides.

stateScopes.identity: project-session/editor/asset/source-revision/payload/page/table/dataset/stable-rows-columns/units/selection
stateScopes.rule: Clipboard text remains separate until a full plan is validated. Apply synchronously into the same parent draft; invalid numeric input stays visible and blocks saving. A changed source, visible ordering, permission, unit or selection retires the plan.

stateScopes.identity: project-session/map-id/accepted-context-token/exact-node-id-and-locator/source-generation/current-value
stateScopes.rule: A runtime-only setting on one active MultiResult. Stored rasters, velocity sampling and duplex live frames receive the same captured value. It follows ResultMapRenderLayer and GeometryMapPoints ForceHorizontalRendering; it never mutates .vis. Each MultiResult has an independent value within its map session; the value may survive a refresh of the same exact node, but a newly opened session starts false.

stateScopes.identity: project-session-ID + canonical-project-path + reference-ID + source-kind/path/SHA/name/embedded-Plan-name
stateScopes.rule: The Swift registry stores HDF references separately from Geometry/Boundary Condition references but returns both in the explicit CoreLayerRequestContext. After the existing project replacement/close guard passes, reset releases any security-scoped HDF URL, clears the import presentation and reference-manager state, and resets both registries; observing a new session ID or canonical project path also clears both reference sets. Neither set is written as project membership, and existing draft save/discard confirmation gates remain in force.

stateScopes.identity: core-layer-context-v1 + current Core captures + optional sorted session-hdf-references-v1 captures
stateScopes.rule: The session HDF token extension is omitted for an empty HDF capture array to preserve the prior token material. Non-empty captures are sorted by ReferenceID and include kind, canonical source path, source SHA, name and embedded Result Plan name. Each Project-rebuilding request must carry its captured context rather than infer ownership from filenames or display labels.

stateScopes.identity: opened-editor-asset-path + old editor baseline/fields/undo state + removed exact session reference
stateScopes.rule: Removing a reference does not delete or save files. An open editor for that exact HDF keeps its draft and baseline but becomes conflicted and cannot save through the removed owner; explicit discard and reload is required. Editors for other assets retain their current drafts.

stateScopes.identity: operation UUID + project session UUID + import presentation UUID + exact map UUID
stateScopes.rule: A Session HDF import may use its own workspace busy slot only with the active exact lease. Other writers, ordinary map mutations, foreign project/presentation/map captures, duplicate acquisition and stale release remain rejected. The provider also verifies the lease project and map against its captured request context before any RPC.

stateScopes.identity: sheet state object + editor object + kind + project session/path + captured DataToolContext
stateScopes.rule: Only a current typed inspection may seed untouched name/start/end values. Form identity replacement clears touch history; inspection refresh within that form preserves edits. Repeated identical seeds perform no editor mutation. Defaults use original unique-filename and project time-window APIs; source checks hash the boundary files captured before creation, not the new staging output added to the in-memory Project.

stateScopes.identity: same MapState + current source capture bounds + actual Canvas currentExtent and pixel dimensions
stateScopes.rule: A .vis source refresh may retire cached aggregate reference points. Current validated associated source bounds may keep the actual finite Canvas viewport publishable until that cache is rebuilt. Bounds are proof of source geometry, never a replacement viewport; source/map revision and viewport generations still fence Host payload installation.

stateScopes.identity: saved map ID + exact source node ID + source-vector instance binding
stateScopes.rule: Capture the exact vector payload ID when the saved tree row arrives, independently of asynchronous source IO completion. Composition joins this ID only to an available validated candidate of the same map; missing data produces no geometry. Tool activation publishes the per-map active tool only after the captured source is revalidated, rather than depending on a mounted menu onChange callback.

stateScopes.identity: physical canonical source path + exact map ID + revision versus persisted node visual binding
