stateScopes.rule: Keep Downloaded Files is false by default. When enabled, retain only files in the exact handoff.files selection (the products still marked IsImporting by the original import action); hidden files remain excluded even when they share a batch. Copy starts before the append sheet, so later append failure or cancellation does not erase the selected raw source. Each selected source must match exactly one captured batch and its owner/token; invalid identity blocks that token without widening the copy set. Failed copies remain token-owned and retryable, while invalid-owner blockers require explicit discard. A project switch cannot reinterpret a captured custom directory; cleanup waits until retention succeeds or the user explicitly discards the temporary source.

stateScopes.identity: closing map ID + same MapState + same ProjectDocument + project session + canonical project path + project revision + verified CoreLayerRequestContext
stateScopes.rule: Capture an immutable context before marking a map tab closing. During that exact map save only, map identity validation may use the capture while the document/session/path/project revision/registry context still match. Live context and reference-list getters remain unavailable during closing; ordinary mutation busy guards stay enforced. Retire the transaction capture on success, failure or cancellation. Physical GeoJSON source caches bind their requesting map and win over legacy global layers only when unique; ambiguous same-map sources are rejected.

stateScopes.identity: exact registered editor and primary kind + ProjectDocument identity + project session/path/revision + asset path/source revision + verified Core context
stateScopes.rule: Capture before marking the editor tab closing; carry only the verified context on this ModelSaveRequest via transient EditorEdits, never persistent draft fields or a global provider override. Apply the committed snapshot against its original registry capture even if the editor closes. Only exact close-editor tree refresh may use the context rebuilt from the accepted new registry revision. A refresh failure preserves the successful commit receipt and never invites duplicate writes.

stateScopes.identity: exact map/editor scope + canonical source file family/SHA + captured path identities + draft generation + ordered source vertices
stateScopes.rule: Successful discard clears drawing/endpoint/DeepConnect/vertex previews and retired async generations only after source/currentness validation. Replacement cardinality never selects additional layer records: mutate only captured path identities. A one-record split copies its ordered attributes to both outputs. GeoJSON Filter uses the exact ordered retained-vertex lineage; Smooth uses original vertex ordinals; preserve original Z/M numeric/null tokens and foreign JSON fields while the existing Host algorithm processes XY. A committed editor may expose the new revision before the raw map cache; accept only that same node/workflow and a unique physical backing at the old or committed revision.

stateScopes.identity: project session + exact saved map/workflow/context + ConceptualMesh locator and Geometry HDF path/SHA + registered parent editor + child draft identity + request generation
stateScopes.rule: The production map palette/input provider dispatches typed spatial selections and map commands to the same registered GeometryTopologySession used by the ordinary Geometry editor. Opening that editor promotes the map-owned parent rather than creating a second transaction. Empty valid topology remains drawable; unavailable or failed source data does not. Selection is not a model edit. Commands use retained source operations and the parent undo journal. Exact multiselected node IDs are captured at drag start. Verified no-op responses preserve the snapshot, completion, diagnostic focus, dirty state and undo/redo. Closing a map retires input ownership without discarding the parent child draft; the parent save is the only HDF commit boundary. Saved Geometry captures use the complete source workflow identity including Result selection context; compare against mapSourceWorkflowIdentity, while the distinct base-map capture retains mapWorkflowIdentity.

stateScopes.identity: persisted vector map/node + full source family revision + original source ordinal/component + exact anchors, or same Geometry topology draft/arc owner
stateScopes.rule: GeoJSON LineString and Polygon outer-ring targets use the first-party filtered reader ordinal and PathIndex zero. Shapefile polygons use flattened first-party ring ordinals, including null-record slots; shapefile polylines retain record and original part ordinals. Derive identity from complete source metadata, never visible row order. Verify supplied project coordinates against the exact retained source path before deriving a directed subsection. SmartAdd and DeepConnect starting on an arc append the retained split and new-arc operations to the same parent journal; do not rewrite the source vector or visualization file. Optional StartNodeFID captures the exact source node from the same current draft and six-cell square; reject simultaneous arc/node targets or out-of-window/missing nodes. SmartAdd samples from the exact selected node, and DeepConnect retains a distinct off-node source anchor as the first internal point after the chosen start node.

stateScopes.identity: exact project session + persisted map/workflows/node/context + original source path/SHA + Core context/result overrides/read lease + stable JSON coordinate path
stateScopes.rule: The source loader and editor sessions use the same captured backend client. Forward-transform every source GeoJSON XY into map/project coordinates before display, hit testing and editing. Inverse-transform a temporary encoded draft before the existing source-SHA compare-and-swap save. Keep raw source bytes and the forward map baseline with the session; restore original XY tokens only at exact unchanged structural coordinate paths, preserving Z/M/null and opaque JSON. Polygon/MultiPolygon rings already exactly closed in current map space retain numeric closure after inverse projection and token restoration, including nested collections and shifted indices. Only the closing XY tokens change when numeric closure was lost; preserve open rings, numerically equal endpoint lexemes, Z/M/null and opaque bytes. Each request is bounded to250000 points; all chunks retain the identical source capture and projection metadata and cancellation is checked between chunks. Retain the exact validated persisted presentation path for format dispatch separately from canonical physical source identity. Format hints select the retained GeoJSON reader; actual bytes and Shapefile sidecars are always read from the captured canonical source. Aliases never change the family/hash/response identity. The source-file SHA is distinct from the aggregate family revision. Never silently use raw source XY when the owner is missing or projection fails. Saved receipts retain the actual committed revision; discard reloads source and forward baseline. A physical GeoJSON file may back several persisted geometry-bucket MapLayer nodes. Validate that the complete captured node-ID set consists of compatible vector nodes; choose a deterministic captured node as the file-scoped projection owner, project the source once, and retain all geometry kinds for exact per-node binding expansion. Multiple legitimate bucket nodes are not stale context. Line and polygon editing scopes retain the format verified from the unique visible persisted map row and its physical-source binding. Palette, DeepConnect, IO dispatch and save receipts use that captured format while reads, writes, SHA and compare-and-swap remain bound to the canonical source; a caller-supplied format hint alone cannot authorize a neutral extension.

stateScopes.identity: pending replacement action + live project session + discard completion + closing/opening phases
stateScopes.rule: Keep isClosingTab during asynchronous discard and retain the current project/action on failure. After successful discard, clear the pending action and confirmation, then release isClosingTab and invoke that captured action in the same MainActor turn without suspension. Replacement creation/opening checks its own guards; retired closing state must not block a valid GIS Mode request. Acceptance waits for both closing and opening phases and a non-nil replacement document.

stateScopes.identity: project session + map ID + exact map-layer node/class/locator identity + diagnostic source identity/revision/status
stateScopes.rule: The ordinary Polyline, Polygon and Point vector map rows reuse CatalogLayerDiagnosticsRow whenever source diagnostics or load errors exist. Rebuild its identity on project/map/source/status transitions so copied diagnostic text and expansion state cannot belong to a retired source. Preserve full messages, read-failure/source-change statuses, filtering and copying; do not replace diagnostics with a presence-only warning icon.

stateScopes.identity: ITerrainInput type + explicit INonPersistableTerrainInput capability + persisted HDF Type/Location fields
stateScopes.rule: The registry discovers only terrain input types that can be reconstructed from HDF. Transient StitchTerrainInput explicitly opts out before constructor probing; FromInputs rejects accidental persistence of such a helper instead of emitting an unreadable row. Do not invent a no-argument constructor for a class whose TryInit/Save do not restore its terrain source. Actual USGS Stitch uses TIFF SmartMerge followed by normal raster conversion/append; Constant and Raster retain their existing persisted type identifiers and source-path roundtrip.

stateScopes.identity: Topology.GlobalMetadata schema column + existing TopoGlobal_ attribute name + declared enum type
stateScopes.rule: Global SizeFunction and PatchType affect regions without control points and must survive Geometry parent save. Write known schema enum values using the existing H5Metadata alias/name string convention; read known names/aliases and defined integral values back to the declared enum type. Missing attributes retain existing Geometry defaults; unknown or invalid values fail explicitly. Graph callers without a topology schema and existing control-point/arc datasets retain their existing paths.

stateScopes.identity: exact map/source owner + selected feature/part identities + per-output source line/vertex provenance
stateScopes.rule: Use the retained PreferClosest merge. Within one MultiLineString retain that feature metadata. Across features remove only the selected paths and append new LineStrings; output schema follows first-seen line properties and original new-row null cells serialize as empty strings. Unselected features and root opaque JSON keep their AST/tokens. Preserve extra coordinate tokens through exact provenance. A disconnected-only empty receipt is a handled no-op for GeoJSON and Shapefile: retain source bytes, existing dirty state and history after exact owner/revision/generation/cancellation checks. A valid disconnected click pair resets its captured pick/preview and selection; a valid disconnected lasso clears its transient line/vertex selection. Cleanup occurs only after exact owner/session/revision/draft unchanged checks and no error, without dirty/history/source changes. Later clicks begin a new pair.

stateScopes.identity: exact source feature/path/segment + coordinate dimension count + original endpoint tokens
stateScopes.rule: XY is finite numeric. Inserting on a line/polygon edge preserves existing numeric interpolation; if either endpoint of an extra ordinate is null the new ordinate remains null. Never invent zero/elevation/measure. Invalid nonnumeric/nonfinite ordinates or mismatched dimensionality reject the operation without document mutation. Existing endpoint numeric tokens and unknown JSON remain unchanged. Polygon loading stores nullable source ordinates explicitly, requires source-coordinate closure, and exposes only finite XY in the numeric compatibility view for null-bearing extended rings. Add-polygon eligibility checks retained source dimension metadata, not that compatibility view.

stateScopes.identity: exact Geometry owner + field key + draft generation + validation task token + request ID

stateScopes.identity: exact Polyline editor scope + map edit owner capture + explicit sheet presentation

stateScopes.identity: fixed localized format key + language resource + opaque CVarArg values

Known complete diagnostic frames may call format while preserving opaque IDs/paths/percent values as arguments.

stateScopes.identity: exact source feature + unique source part ordinals + original DBF row index and typed/display values + line/vertex XYZM provenance
